title: Architecture Deep Research — Where to Dig Deeper
description: Research threads to deepen evidence on the highest-spread axes from this run. Each entry names a high-spread axis, the next research dig framed as a question, and a pre-filled `adr deep-research` command the user can paste to chase it.

axis.description: Axis id from the comparison matrix (e.g. 'deployment_model', 'pricing_model').

spread_score.description: Variance score across candidate verdicts on this axis. Higher = the axis genuinely discriminates.

question.description: Sharp 1-sentence research thread to deepen evidence on this axis.

suggested_command.description: Pre-filled `adr deep-research` command the user can paste to chase the thread.
